title: Tool Crib Panel + TDB Import
description: Build the PRISM Tool Crib panel for hyperMILL. Provides searchable access to the 95,608-tool catalog from within hyperMILL. Includes 'Import to TDB' button that exports selected tools to hyperMILL's tool database (.hmt SQLite format) via HyperMillToolExportEngine. Tool availability check against shop crib inventory. Collision geometry preview for holder + tool assembly.

forge_triple.hook: hm-plugin:tool-import-validation — BUILT (validates tool geometry compatibility before .hmt import)
forge_triple.action: hypermill_plugin:search_tool_catalog — BUILT (searches 95K tools with fuzzy match)
forge_triple.skill: /hypermill-tool-crib — BUILT (search, preview, and import tools into hyperMILL TDB)

sessions.title: Tool Search + Catalog Action
sessions.intent: Build the tool search action with fuzzy matching across 95K tools, and the panel UI with search bar, filter facets, and result cards showing tool geometry previews.

units.title: Tool Catalog Search Action
units.description: Create hypermill_plugin:search_tool_catalog action that searches the 95,608-tool ToolRegistry with fuzzy matching on: tool type, diameter, flute count, material, manufacturer, coating, overall length. Support faceted filtering (type, diameter range, material grade). Return top-20 results ranked by relevance with geometry summary. Performance target: <200ms for any query.
units.four_loop: BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP
exit_criteria: Fuzzy search returns relevant results for partial names (e.g., 'sandvik 12mm' finds CoroMill entries)
Faceted filters narrow results by tool type, diameter range, and coating
Search latency <200ms for 95K catalog with cold cache

units.title: Tool Crib Panel HTML/JS UI
units.description: Build the Tool Crib panel with: search bar with auto-suggest, filter sidebar (type, diameter, manufacturer, coating), result cards showing tool geometry SVG preview + key specs (D, L, Z, corner radius). Paginated results (20 per page). Tool detail expansion showing full geometry dimensions, recommended cutting data, and holder compatibility.
units.four_loop: BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP
exit_criteria: Search bar triggers search on 300ms debounce with auto-suggest dropdown
Result cards show tool type icon, diameter, length, flute count, and manufacturer
Tool detail expansion shows full geometry dimensions with SVG cross-section preview

sessions.exit_gate: Search returns relevant results <200ms + panel displays tool cards with geometry | omega_floor >= 0.90

sessions.title: TDB Import + Inventory Check
sessions.intent: Build the Import to TDB button that exports selected tools to hyperMILL's .hmt SQLite format, and add shop crib inventory status checking.

units.title: HMT Import Action + Geometry Mapping
units.description: Create hypermill_plugin:import_to_tdb action that takes a selected tool from the catalog and exports it to hyperMILL's tool database via HyperMillToolExportEngine. Map PRISM's tool geometry to hyperMILL's 29 geometry classes (flat endmill, ball nose, bull nose, drill, tap, etc.). Handle holder selection and tool assembly creation. Write .hmt SQLite file to hyperMILL's TDB path.
units.four_loop: BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP
exit_criteria: Tool geometry correctly mapped to one of 29 hyperMILL geometry classes
.hmt SQLite file written with valid schema (tested with hyperMILL's TDB reader)
Holder + tool assembly created with correct coupling dimensions

units.title: Inventory Check + Collision Preview
units.description: Add shop crib inventory status to tool search results (in-stock/low/out-of-stock badge). Wire ToolInventoryEngine to check tool availability. Add collision geometry preview that shows holder + tool assembly outline for the selected tool against the current workpiece bounding box. 'Import to TDB' button disabled for out-of-stock tools with reorder suggestion.
units.four_loop: BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP
exit_criteria: Inventory status badge (green=in-stock, yellow=low, red=out) shown on each tool card
Collision geometry preview renders 2D side-view of holder+tool assembly outline
Out-of-stock tools show 'Reorder' link instead of 'Import to TDB' button

sessions.exit_gate: Import creates valid .hmt + inventory badges shown + collision preview renders | omega_floor >= 0.90
